fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local political coverage ahead of Miami city commission elections, including a poll-style candidate list and commentary on campaign conditions. Major articles discuss Jose Aleman and alleged influence on immigration enforcement, including the transfer of an immigration inspector; coverage also critiques the Miami Herald’s reporting on a "baby-racket"/adoption case and argues against monopolization of adoption arrangements. Additional reporting covers the long-running Miami Beach public-beach legal dispute and contempt proceedings, police and vagrancy court activity in Miami, reforms requiring contractor qualification in unincorporated Dade County, and Coral Gables zoning enforcement against room rentals. Regular features include sports commentary and assorted advertisements and entertainment listings.
